# Yotpo

> Yotpo is an eCommerce retention and AI-visibility platform that helps brands get found, earn trust, and turn one-time shoppers into repeat customers and advocates. Its core connected products - Reviews & UGC and Loyalty & Referrals - run on shared first-party shopper data, and its AI suite (Yotpo Discover, plus CommerceGPT / Answer Engine Optimization) helps brands stay visible inside AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and agentic-commerce shopping experiences. Yotpo integrates deeply with Shopify, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Adobe Commerce (Magento), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce and 150+ marketing, CX and commerce tools.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (see https://llmstxt.org). It is a curated, human-maintained map of the most useful, evergreen URLs on https://www.yotpo.com, intended to help LLMs and AI search/answer engines understand Yotpo's products, evidence, and educational content. Every URL below was verified live and returning HTTP 200 as of August 2026. Deep inventories (1,190+ glossary entries, 4,080+ blog posts, 169 integrations, 100+ case studies) are linked at their hub pages rather than enumerated in full.

Many pages are also published as clean Markdown: append `.md` to the URL (for example https://www.yotpo.com/pricing.md, https://www.yotpo.com/platform/reviews.md, https://www.yotpo.com/explore.md). Markdown coverage currently spans the product, pricing and solution pages listed below; it is being extended to the rest of the site.

## Key facts

- Company: Yotpo Ltd., an eCommerce retention marketing platform.
- Core products: Reviews & UGC (including visual UGC) and Loyalty & Referrals, plus AI Visibility - Yotpo Discover (AI visibility platform) and CommerceGPT (answer-engine optimization).
- Core commerce platforms: Shopify & Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Adobe Commerce / Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce.
- Positioning: a connected retention stack built on shared first-party shopper data, focused on reviews, loyalty and AI visibility.
- AI crawler policy: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther and Applebot are all explicitly allowed in robots.txt.
- Content signals: every crawler group in robots.txt declares `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes` (see https://contentsignals.org) - Yotpo's published content may be indexed for search, used as grounding input for AI answers, and used for AI training.
